# googleads_ad_group_asset (Resource)

Links an asset (sitelink, callout, structured snippet, etc.) to an ad group with a specific `field_type`. The triple (ad_group, asset, field_type) is immutable; only `status` mutates in place. Scoped narrower than `googleads_campaign_asset` — use this when an extension should only show for one ad group rather than the whole campaign.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_ad_group_asset" "callout" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id = googleads_ad_group.brand.id
  asset_id    = googleads_callout_asset.free_shipping.id
  field_type  = "CALLOUT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ad_group_id` (String) Parent ad group resource name. Immutable.
- `asset_id` (String) Asset resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `field_type` (String) How the asset is used in the ad group. Common: SITELINK, CALLOUT, STRUCTURED_SNIPPET, MOBILE_APP, CALL, PROMOTION, PRICE. Immutable.

### Optional

- `status` (String) ENABLED (default), PAUSED, or REMOVED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/adGroupAssets/{ad_group_id}~{asset_id}~{field_type}).
